title: Somnath – Dwarka
subtitle: Dwarkadish Temple · Somnath Jyotirlinga · Girnar Darshan · Bet Dwarka
inclusions: AC Tempo Traveler for local sightseeing
exclusions: Anything which is not mentioned in Inclusions

travel.departure: Mumbai Central Railway Station — 8:00 PM, 26 Nov 2026 (Train: Saurashtra Mail 22945)
travel.arrival: Reach Mumbai by 06:00 AM, 2nd Dec 2026 (Saurashtra Janta Express 19218 from Junagadh)

itinerary.title: Train Travelling (Mumbai to Dwarka)
itinerary.description: Reporting Station: Mumbai Central Railway Station. Reporting Time: 08:00 PM. Train: Saurashtra Mail. Board train for Dwarka. Overnight journey.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing in Dwarka
itinerary.description: Reach Dwarka railway station by 01:15 PM. Reach Hotel and check in. Have lunch (at your own cost) in the hotel. Proceed for sightseeing: visit Dwarkadish Temple and take blessings of Lord Krishna. Next visit Rukmini Temple. Get back to hotel, have dinner and rest.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing in Dwarka & Somnath Jyotirlinga
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from hotel. Start your day with Bet Dwarka darshan. Next visit the Lord Shiva's famous Nageshwar Temple. Enroute have lunch (at your own expense) and continue journey to Somnath (4.5 hrs). Spend evening at the sacred Somnath Jyotirlinga. Proceed to hotel check in, have dinner and take rest.

itinerary.title: Sightseeing in Somnath & Travel to Girnar
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and check out from hotel. Start your day sightseeing with Bhalka Teerth, the place where Lord Krishna drew his final breath. Next visit Geeta Mandir and Triveni Sangam. Post lunch move to Girnar (2.5 hrs). Reach Girnar and proceed to hotel check in, have dinner and take rest.

itinerary.title: Girnar Darshan
itinerary.description:
Early morning start journey towards Girnar Darshan. Enroute have breakfast (at your own expense). Reach Ropeway point and head to the top. Complete Girnar Darshan. Return back to Hotel, have dinner and take rest.

NOTE: Participants should book their ropeway tickets online from udankhatola.com. Time slot: 07 AM - 08 AM.

itinerary.title: Catch Train for Mumbai
itinerary.description: Enjoy breakfast and get ready to return home. Check out from hotel and head towards Junagadh station. Board train around 12:58 PM. Train: Saurashtra Janta Express.

itinerary.title: Reach Mumbai
itinerary.description: Reach Mumbai by 06:00 AM. Return home with sweet memories!
